description: One search over several scopes (plan 2026-10-28 §4.5, the Search Fabric): network (Search's index, permission-aware as search.query.run), mine (the person's own private documents), web (OpenVibe's open index, then paid providers in a ladder, cached), with route.explain saying what answered and what it cost. Anonymous callers get network results and web results from the open index and the cache; a signed-in person or a first-party service (X-OV-Subject for mine) also reaches paid providers within OpenVibe's daily caps. Providers never receive an account identifier. The same operation is the SDK's createSearchClient().query() and the MCP tool openvibe.search.
